newsitem.title: USA: Healthcare consents to SEC settlement.
newsitem.headline: Healthcare consents to SEC settlement.

text.p: Healthcare Services Group Inc said Tuesday it has given its final consent to a previously announced settlement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
The settlement involves its filings from 1991 and earlier and was filed with the U.S. District Court of Eastern Pennsylvania, the company said.

The company stated that "it was in its long-term best interest to conclude the matter without admitting or denying any wrong-doing by it or its officers, agree to a penalty to settle the matter and concentrate its resources and energies on the company's future."
In March the company said the SEC investigation and other matters negatively affected its 1995 net income by about $2.3 million.
